description: Use when you will call the data routes often for up to seven days. For thirty days use buy_month_pass; for a single call, call the data tool directly. Check a key's expiry with check_pass. A seven-day fair-use access pass: returns a private key and expiry for the eight data routes; send the key as a Bearer token. Fair use applies. Call without payment to see the offer; pay to get the key. No parameters. Costs $3 USDC via x402; without payment returns an offer. No account or API key required. USDC on Base or Solana. Retrying the same payment reuses a remembered settlement when its record is available; availability is not guaranteed.
name: buy_week_pass
title: Pay: Seven-day access pass
